about: See Image is a simple testing platform for image generation, for individual users. It was built by an Arab team led by Mahmoud Saad, based in Faqous, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt.
Two models: See Image 1.0 Mini for speed and See Image 1.0 Large for top precision.
Bulk production is not done on the platform — it goes through third-party API providers.
The platform is under preparation and will open when the models launch — Mini first, then Large.
apiNote: Bulk production runs through third-party API providers, not through this platform.

privacy: See AI — Faqous, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt. Email: See@seeai.xyz. We are responsible for your personal data.
Your email address when you join the waitlist — nothing else. We do not collect your phone number or any other data. Your IP address also reaches us technically when you visit the site.
Only to notify you when the platform launches, with your explicit consent when you sign up. We do not use your email for any other purpose.

Waitlist messages reach our inbox through FormSubmit. ProxyCheck processes visitor IP addresses to detect VPN, proxy, Tor and hosting connections. Google crawler IP ranges are used to verify genuine Google search crawlers. We do not sell your data.
Waitlist messages may be stored on servers outside Egypt through our email provider, with your explicit consent when you sign up, in line with Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020.

You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing and withdraw your consent at any time — email us at See@seeai.xyz and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the Personal Data Protection Center.
We keep your email until launch or until you ask us to delete it. Security checks use short-lived in-memory IP decisions; the website does not set language preferences or tracking cookies.

terms: By using See Image you agree to this agreement. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.

See Image is an image-generation testing platform, still under preparation. The models are not available yet and will open at launch — Mini first, then Large. Features and prices may change before launch.
When the platform opens, sign-in will be by phone number, and you are responsible for your account and all activity under it.
Do not create illegal or abusive content, infringe others’ rights, or impersonate real people, and do not use the platform for any unlawful purpose.
You own the images you create within the limits of the law, and grant us the right to run and show them to you only. The images shown on the home page are illustrative examples, not model output.
At launch, credits will be deducted on every generation according to the selected model. Official prices will be announced before launch, and no charges will apply before then.

The service is provided “as is” without any warranty. We are not liable for any harm arising from using the platform. This agreement is governed by Egyptian law, and the Egyptian courts have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.
